extra.message: User-controlled zipCode is concatenated directly into a native SQL string and passed to EntityManager.createNativeQuery(). The value originates from the POST parameter in ProviderController.search() (body.get("zipCode")) and flows unvalidated into the query, allowing SQL injection (e.g. zipCode = "' OR 1=1 --").

The H2 web console is enabled (spring.h2.console.enabled=true) and exposed at /h2-console with the datasource using username 'sa' and an empty password. This exposes an unauthenticated database administration console that can be leveraged to read or modify all application data, and combined with the SQL injection can lead to further compromise.
